**Finding: compliant** — no redline proposed.

The assignment clause (p0072) already delivers the preferred position for us: we may assign without consent to an affiliate, to a purchaser of all or substantially all assets relating to the Agreement, or to a successor by merger, stock sale or consolidation; any other assignment needs consent that cannot be unreasonably withheld. The Agreement contains no change-of-control provision at all, so the Vendor has no termination or re-pricing right on our change of control — the walk-away risk is absent.

Two minor points noted for the record but not flagged: the carve-out is mutual (so the Vendor may likewise assign to its affiliate or acquirer without our consent), and there is no express bar on assignment to one of our competitors. Neither is material against the fallback, and we would raise them only if the negotiation reopens this section.
